description: This file defines classes and methods for fetching, processing, and transforming Fama-French regional portfolio return data, including query parameter definitions, data models, and a fetcher class with data extraction and transformation logic.

classes.name: FamaFrenchRegionalPortfolioReturnsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching regional portfolio returns, including portfolio selection, measure, frequency, and date range.

classes.name: FamaFrenchRegionalPortfolioReturnsData
classes.description: Data model representing individual entries of regional portfolio returns, including date, portfolio, measure, and value.

classes.name: FamaFrenchRegionalPortfolioReturnsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class responsible for extracting and transforming regional portfolio return data from the Fama-French FTP.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FamaFrenchRegionalPortfolioReturnsQueryParams object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches portfolio data from the Fama-French FTP based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into a structured, flattened format suitable for analysis, handling missing data and date filtering.
